title: My Week
text:
Monday is my busy day. I go to school. On Tuesday, I play football with my friend.

On Saturday, I visit my grandmother. We cook lunch together. Sunday is my favorite day because I rest at home.

questions.text: What do I do on Monday?
Who do I visit on Saturday?
Which day is the writer probably the most relaxed?
Why does the writer probably like their grandmother?
options: They spend time together on Saturday

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
to go to see a person or place

paragraph_translations: Понеділок - мій зайнятий день. Я ходжу до школи. У вівторок я граю у футбол з другом.
У суботу я відвідую бабусю. Ми разом готуємо обід. Неділя - мій улюблений день, тому що я відпочиваю вдома.
